criterion_text: A release build emits auditable config and artifact identity, and Compose cannot silently build a mismatched Web vs Server/Agent configuration.

verifiers.summary: One release parameter reaches the Web bundle and the Server process configuration, agrees on cols, defaults deterministically and fails fast on invalid values

evidence.value: exact SHA 051cef1dba62c10e44722e57ed77737902d39880: render-server-config.sh projected cols=96/font=13.5 into config.toml and `nession-server --print-config` read back 96/13.5 through its canonical parser and validation
the Web bundle built from the same 96/13.5 parameters emitted 96/13.5; omitted inputs read back as 96/14 in both the renderer and the Server parser
cols=0, cols=eighty and font=32.1 each failed the Server reader visibly; the entrypoint writes the values and the runtime environment overrides and validates them
both Server/Agent image paths carry ARG+ENV, Compose states both variables, and both release workflows pass the Web build inputs and the image build args from one parameter source
